boundary.what_this_does_not_establish: nothing here shows that additional passes reason. It shows whether the same frozen weights answer differently with more internal computation, on this panel, at this course size, from one matched initialization

panel.what_this_panel_can_support: an application measurement on unexamined material

plan.boundary: derived planning counts, not measured GPU work; equal teaching exposure is not equal training compute, and eight internal passes are eight sample passes and ONE optimizer update

maintenance.consequence: a different maintenance source changes what the maintenance phase rehearses. Both conditions use the same source, so the comparison is unaffected; the absolute numbers are conditional on this choice and are reported as such
maintenance.source: the constructor plan declares the allowance but not WHICH decisions. The default here replays the same cohort's previous visit's return-to-cube decisions (8 events, one batch of 8)

course.matching: the one-pass condition is depths=(1,)*16: same events, same starting weights, same batches, same updates

declared_cost.boundary: derived planning counts, not measured GPU work; encoding, backward computation, readout, checkpointing and evaluation add their own cost

R1.meaning: the matched one-pass condition; identical to the existing learner's computation

R8.meaning: eight passes, state carried: the primary allowance

RESET_8.meaning: eight computations with the state discarded between them: a mechanism check, not a second architecture

implemented_calls.convention: one transformation call per question, which is what GraphLearner.forward issues today; a genuinely batched loader would issue the declared 128 / 480
